verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm developers can be invited free to inspect designs in a web browser, with no Mac app or editor seat needed, and can 'grab the information they need for any part of a design.' The evidence does not spell out what that information includes. Measurements, styles and asset export are only implied, and there is no mention of platform-specific code snippets. missing for 10: explicit evidence of measurements/spacing inspection, style values, asset export, CSS/iOS/Android code snippets, independent or hands-on corroboration.
